content: Tat pratishedhartham eka tattva abhyasah. (To overcome mental scatterings, practice focusing one-pointedly on a single principle).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Tat pratishedhartham eka tattva abhyasah. (To overcome menta...) focuses directly on pratishedhartham and tattva. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on pratishedhartham today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper pratishedhartham and tattva in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
